crossRefs.note: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.
Yahweh, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.
If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…

translations.web: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.
translations.bsb: He is the foremost of God’s works; only his Maker can draw the sword against him.
translations.kjv: He is the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach
translations.asv: He is the chief of the ways of God: He only that made him giveth him his sword.
